in_sanskrit.name: Malesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Mountain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Malesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Malesh is a Hindu name meaning 'Lord of the Mountain'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mahadeva', which means 'great god'. Malesh is a powerful and strong name, evoking images of the mighty Himalayas and the gods that reside there.
